title: Care Tier Transport Credit
content:
## Care tier transport credit schedule

Under the Medicaid Managed Care Membership, the re-rated copay of an ambulance transport under review is lowered by a care tier credit that follows the care management tier of an episode in the member's Care Management records enrolled in the twelve months before the review date.

| Care Management episode enrolled in the twelve months | Care tier credit |
|---|---|
| Care Coordination Level 2 or Complex Case Management | 1.00 USD (high-tier care credit) |
| Any other tier (for example Healthy Living Support, Care Coordination Level 1, Maternal Care Management, Health Home Services, LTSS Service Coordination) | 0.50 USD (base-tier care credit) |
| No episode enrolled in those months | none |

**Clause.** A Care Coordination Level 2 or Complex Case Management episode enrolled in the twelve months before the review date earns the high-tier care credit of 1.00 USD, any other episode enrolled in those months earns the base-tier care credit of 0.50 USD, and no episode enrolled in those months earns no care tier credit. An episode is enrolled in those months when its enrollment date lies fewer than twelve whole months before the review date.

The care tier credit is subtracted from the re-rated ambulance copay, and that copay, after the credits subtracted from it, is never below zero.

## Notes

- Where episodes of both kinds were enrolled in the twelve months, the high-tier credit of 1.00 USD applies.
- An episode enrolled earlier than the twelve months earns nothing, even where it is still open.
